newsitem.title: USA: Community Care target of criminal probe.
newsitem.headline: Community Care target of criminal probe.

text.p: Community Care Services Inc said Tuesday the company and its chief executive and chief operating officers are targets of a federal criminal investigation involving allegedly improper Medicare payments.
The company said it and its officers deny any and all wrongdoing.
The company said the U.S. Department of Justice is investigating allegedly improper payments relating to a contract to provide healthcare services outside New York State involving Medicare.
Government officials have executed a search warrant at the company's executive offices, it said.
